blocks.text: Women appearing in public without wearing a hijab has become an increasingly common sight across Iran, marking one of the most visible social changes since the 2022 “Woman, Life, Freedom” protests, which were sparked after a woman died in police custody after she was arrested for allegedly wearing her headscarf improperly. Authorities have been unable to restore the level of street enforcement that existed before the protests. But the relative retreat of so-called “morality police” patrols does not mean the compulsory hijab has disappeared.
